name: perspective.rename
title: Rename perspective
summary: Give a perspective a new name; its file is renamed to match, and comments and description stay.
details: The new name is checked as when saving and must not be another perspective's, in any case or Unicode normal form; changing only the case of the own name is allowed, and the same name writes nothing. The file is named as a new file for the new name would be, the own file not counted as taken; when the name part without a suffix is its file name in any case, the file name stays. Errors: input.invalid at `name` when no perspective has it, at `newName` when another perspective has it (details.files); file.faulty when only a faulty file holds either name (details.files); file.folder-missing when the folder's repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder for a place in Git (D-036); file.changed-on-disk when the file changed since it was read. When the name in the renamed file cannot be written, the file is renamed back and nothing is changed; if that fails too, details.written names the file under its new path, and the same call again finishes the rename.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-217 AK7: renaming is refused while the tool refuses write commands (SR-011 AK3).

name.description: The perspective to rename, by its name in any case or Unicode normal form.

newName.description: The new name, checked as when saving; it must not be another perspective's. The file is renamed to match.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root; a renamed file under its new path.

renamed.title: Renamed files
renamed.description: The renamed file: its path before and after, relative to the workspace root. Empty when the file name stays.
